steps_raw.instruction: Pulling Pipettes using the DMZ-Zeitz Universal
Scope and Applicability: For the manufacture of glass pipettes for patch clamp electrophysiology using the DMZ-Zeitz Universal puller.
Glass capillaries (Sutter Instruments BF150-86-10 or equivalent)
Internal solution (RP0234)
Pipette storage box (Sutter Instruments BX20)
3.0 mm heating filaments (DMZ-Zeitz Universal)
Pipette puller (DMZ-Zeitz Universal)
Pulled micropipette of desired length, taper, tip size, and resistance.
Patch pipettes of equal length with tip diameter of 1-1.5 µm and resistance of 3-6 MΩ.
RP0234 Electrode Internal Solution with Biocytin II
https://www.protocols.io/view/electrode-internal-solution-with-biocytin-ii-bepnjdme/abstract
PF0298 Multi-Patch Clamp Recording
https://www.protocols.io/view/multi-patch-clamp-recording-bdpgi5jw/abstract
https://www.protocols.io/view/artificial-cerebrospinal-fluid-ix-acsf-ix-beppjdmn/abstract
Operation Manual: DMZ-Zeitz Universal Puller
https://www.zeitz-puller.com/support/maintenance/
Warning: Personal Protective Equipment () should be used at all times while operating this protocol. If you are unsure what you should be using, see your immediate supervisor.
Turn on the power to the pipette puller.
Methodology/Procedures:
Pipettes Used for Whole Cell Patch Clamp Recording
To pull pipettes using an established program:
Turn on puller using MAINS switch
Press P(A), enter desired program number, press E, and press Ready
Insert a glass pipette into the open glass holders.
On the left DMZ-Zeitz puller, ensure the pipette is pushed all the way to the right, making contact with the right positioning knob (Figure 1)
On the right DMZ-Zeitz puller, push the glass pipette all the way to the left, making contact with the stop (Figure 2).
Close the safety shield
Press START to run the program and pull pipettes.
Place pulled pipettes into a storage box for further use.
Creating a New Program for Pipettes Used for Whole Cell Patch Clamp Recording:
Select an open, unused program number.
Set up the program with the initial values for a patching pipette found in the operation manual for a single pull program (Table 1).
For single pull programs, the first digit of P(B)AD = 0. Otherwise, the first digit represents the time of polishing protocol.
Consult manual for explanations of each value.
Table 1: Initial parameters for single pull program
Pull pipettes as described in previous section (8.1.1)
Measure the resistance and diameter of the pipette:
Fill the pipette with internal solution (SOP RP0234).
Fill the bath with ACSF.IX (SOP RP0233)
Load pipette onto a head stage of an Ephys Rig. Only measure one pipette in the bath at one time.
Lower the pipette into the bath and apply a 10 mV test pulse to determine the resistance of the tip (Figure 3).
Measure the tip diameter under high magnification. Measure across the darkest part of the tip.
Correct the pipette resistance and diameter:
Adjust P(A)H to maintain a first pull duration of approximately 25 s.
Adjust P(B)t(F1) to adjust diameter/resistance. Increase P(B)t(F1) for a larger diameter/lower resistance, and lower P(B)t(F1) for a smaller diameter/higher resistance.
Pull 3 sets of pipettes from the new program to ensure consistency of resistances within the desired range (3-6 MΩ) and diameter (1-1.5 µm).
Ensure the safety shield is closed.
Turn of pipette puller.
Technical Information:
Changing the Filament
The operations manual (https://www.zeitz-puller.com/support/maintenance/) has full instructions for changing the puller filament, consult for more detail.
Turn the puller off and unplug.
Wait 5 minutes for heating mechanism to cool down if it was in use.
Remove the 4 screws holding the lower part of the right-hand cover panel
Grasp the panel at the right-hand corner and remove it by pulling it up and towards yourself.
Give the spindle a few turns using a screwdriver inserted in the slit until the heating filament holder is in its most advanced position.
Do not screw the spindle out completely!
Loosen the small black grub screw of the upper filament holder using the hexagonal key from the spare parts box.
Loosen the knurled screw of the lower filament holder.
Pull the filament out of the slots.
Insert new filament as far as it will go into the slots.
Partially and gently tighten the screws.
Adjust the horizontal and vertical position of the filament by moving the upper and lower parts of the filament.
Ensure that you do not bend the filament
Tighten the screws and screw the metal cover back into place.
Leave the heater in its advanced position
Do not screw the spindle completely out of its hole.
